title: The Deadline of the DMZ
author: Coral Eastwick
blurb: Sebastian Almeida, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
